22518-quaint-epitaphs.title: Quaint Epitaphs
22518-quaint-epitaphs.creator: Unknown
22518-quaint-epitaphs.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The compiler trusts that it is not an act of unreasonable presumption to publish a book of epitaphs when so many already exist. In fact it was partly because of the numerous requests for an examination of her collection that the plan of publishing it was adopted.

arxiv-1805-04972.title: NLO QCD corrections to single vector-like top partner production in association with top quark at the LHC
arxiv-1805-04972.creator: Mohamed Sadek Zidi
arxiv-1805-04972.description: Abstract The single vector-like top partner hadroproduction in association with top quark in the five and the six-flavour schemes at the LHC is investigated. The inclusive cross section and the differential distributions are evaluated for many benchmark scenarios at leading and next-to-leading orders, both for fixed-order and fixed-order matched to parton shower.

arxiv-2105-10124.title: RLIRank: Learning to Rank with Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Search DOI: 10.1145/3366423.3380047 Conference: Proceedings of The Web Conference 2020; April 20–24, 2020; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of The Web Conference 2020 (WWW ’20), April 20–24, 2020, Taipei, Taiwan ISBN: 978-1-4503-7023-3/20/0
arxiv-2105-10124.creator: Jianghong Zhou, Eugene Agichtein
arxiv-2105-10124.description: Abstract . To support complex search tasks, where the initial information requirements are complex or may change during the search, a search engine must adapt the information delivery as the user’s information requirements evolve. To support this dynamic ranking paradigm effectively, search result ranking must incorporate both the user feedback received, and the information displayed so far.

arxiv-2209-00070.title: SQM2022: Theoretical Summary
arxiv-2209-00070.creator: \firstname Berndt \lastname Müller \fnsep
arxiv-2209-00070.description: Abstract Written version of the theoretical summary lecture presented at the Strangeness in Quark Matter 2022 conference. 1 Introduction In his Theoretical Overview, J. Kapusta Kapusta described a large array of topics and open questions that fall within the purview of this conference series.

arxiv-2212-13445.title: The most general manner to injectively align true and predicted segments
arxiv-2212-13445.creator: Maarten Marx
arxiv-2212-13445.description: Abstract Kirilov et al (2019) develop a metric, called Panoptic Quality (PQ) , to evaluate image segmentation methods. The metric is based on a confusion table, and compares a predicted to a ground truth segmentation. The only non straightforward part in this comparison is to align the segments in the two segmentations.

arxiv-2403-08931.title: Unleashing the True Power of Age-of-Information: Service Aggregation in Connected and Autonomous Vehicles This work was supported by funds from Toyota Motor North America and by the US National Science Foundation (NSF) under Grant No. 1910667, 1910891, and 2025284.
arxiv-2403-08931.creator: Anik Mallik 1 , Dawei Chen 2 , Kyungtae Han 2 , Jiang Xie 1 , and Zhu Han 3
arxiv-2403-08931.description: Abstract Connected and autonomous vehicles (CAVs) rely heavily upon time-sensitive information update services to ensure the safety of people and assets, and satisfactory entertainment applications. Therefore, the freshness of information is a crucial performance metric for CAV services. However, information from roadside sensors and nearby vehicles can get delayed in transmission due to the high mobility of vehicles.

arxiv-2404-16629.title: Implementing and Optimizing the Scaled Dot-Product Attention on Streaming Dataflow
arxiv-2404-16629.creator: Gina Sohn, Nathan Zhang, Kunle Olukotun
arxiv-2404-16629.description: Abstract . Transformer models serve as the backbone of many state-of-the-art language models, and most use the scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) mechanism to capture relationships between tokens. However, the straightforward implementation of SDPA has quadratic compute and memory complexity with respect to the sequence length.

arxiv-2405-01185.title: Third medium finite element contact formulation for pneumatically actuated systems
arxiv-2405-01185.creator: Ondřej Faltus, Martin Horák, Martin Doškář, Ondřej Rokoš
arxiv-2405-01185.description: Abstract Mechanical metamaterials are artificially engineered microstructures that exhibit novel mechanical behavior on the macroscopic scale. Active metamaterials can be externally controlled. For instance, pneumatically actuated metamaterials can change their mechanical, acoustic, or other types of effective behavior in response to applied pressure with possible applications ranging from soft robotic actuators to phononic crystals.

arxiv-2406-00732.title: A Digital Twin Framework for Reinforcement Learning with Real-Time Self-Improvement via Human Assistive Teleoperation
arxiv-2406-00732.creator: Kabirat Olayemi, Mien Van*, Luke Maguire, Sean McLoone
arxiv-2406-00732.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning (RL) or Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) is a powerful approach to solving Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) when the model of the environment is not known a priori. However, RL models are still faced with challenges such as handling covariate shifts and ensuring the quality of human demonstration.

arxiv-2407-06047.title: Effects of stratification on overshooting and waves atop the convective core of 5 ​ M ☉ 5M_{\astrosun} main-sequence stars
arxiv-2407-06047.creator: A. Morison, A. Le Saux, I. Baraffe, J. Morton, T. Guillet, D. G. Vlaykov, T. Goffrey, J. Pratt
arxiv-2407-06047.description: Abstract As a massive star evolves along the main sequence, its core contracts, leaving behind a stable stratification in helium. We simulate 2D convection in the core at three different stages of evolution of a 5 ​ M ☉ 5M_{\astrosun} star, with three different stratifications in helium atop the core.

arxiv-2409-02746.title: A Systematic Survey of Moon-Forming Giant Impacts. II. Rotating bodies Facilities: Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (Piz Daint, Eiger@Alps)
arxiv-2409-02746.creator: Thomas Meier, Christian Reinhardt, Miles Timpe, Joachim Stadel, Ben Moore
arxiv-2409-02746.description: Abstract In the leading theory of lunar formation, known as the giant impact hypothesis, a collision between two planet-size objects resulted in a young Earth surrounded by a circumplanetary debris disk from which the Moon later accreted. The range of giant impacts that could conceivably explain the Earth-Moon system is limited by the set of known physical and geochemical constraints.

arxiv-2502-09288.title: AI Safety for Everyone
arxiv-2502-09288.creator: Balint Gyevnar, Atoosa Kasirzadeh
arxiv-2502-09288.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Balint Gyevnar, Atoosa Kasirzadeh. Recent discussions and research in AI safety have increasingly emphasized the deep connection between AI safety and existential risk from advanced AI systems, suggesting that work on AI safety necessarily entails serious consideration of potential existential threats.

arxiv-2507-05054.title: Work and entropy of mixing in isolated quantum systems
arxiv-2507-05054.creator: Budhaditya Bhattacharjee, Rohit Kishan Ray, Dominik Šafránek
arxiv-2507-05054.description: Abstract The mixing of two different gases is one of the most common natural phenomena, with applications ranging from CO 2 \text{CO}_{2} capture to water purification. Traditionally, mixing is analyzed in the context of local thermal equilibrium, where systems exchange energy with a heat bath.

arxiv-2510-16933.title: Tutoring LLM into a Better CUDA Optimizer
arxiv-2510-16933.creator: Matyáš Brabec, Jiří Klepl, Michal Töpfer, Martin Kruliš
arxiv-2510-16933.description: Abstract Recent leaps in large language models (LLMs) caused a revolution in programming tools (like GitHub Copilot) that can help with code generation, debugging, and even performance optimization. In this paper, we focus on the capabilities of the most recent reasoning models to generate optimized CUDA code for predefined, well-known tasks.

pmc-10649713.title: Association between antibiotics and asthma risk among adults aged over 40 years: a nationally representative retrospective cohort study
pmc-10649713.creator: Jiwon Choi, Sun Jae Park, Young Jun Park, Jaeyi Hong, Seogsong Jeong, Jooyoung Chang, Sung Min Kim, Jihun Song, Yoosun Cho, Sang Min Park
pmc-10649713.description: IntroductionSeveral studies have reported that exposure to antibiotics can lead to asthma during early childhood. However, the association between antibiotic use and risk of asthma in the adult population remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the association between antibiotic use and asthma in adults.

pmc-11452853.title: “Backlash!”? A qualitative exploration of hospice palliative care staff’s ongoing experiences of “living with covid”
pmc-11452853.creator: Rebecca Evans, John MacArtney
pmc-11452853.description: Background:“Living with covid” has meant that the SARS-CoV-2 virus has become a background concern for many in the United Kingdom. However, people with terminal conditions remain some of those at higher risk of Covid-19 affecting the quality-of-life left, as well as the amount of life.

pmc-12654076.title: Baculovirus-Displayed ASFV Epitope-Composite Protein Elicits Potent Immune Responses
pmc-12654076.creator: Wenkai Zhang, Xing Yang, Xingyu Chen, Jiaxin Jin, Yuanyuan Zhang, Lele Gong, Shuai Zhang, Xuyang Zhao, Yongkun Du, Yanan Wu, Aijun Sun, Guoqing Zhuang
pmc-12654076.description: African swine fever (ASF), caused by the African swine fever virus (ASFV), is an acute, febrile, highly contagious, and lethal disease that poses a severe threat to the global pig farming industry. Currently, no globally recognized, safe, and effective commercial ASF vaccine has been developed, making vaccination a crucial strategy for outbreak control.

pmc-12730464.title: Hybrid ANFIS–MPA and FFNN–MPA Models for Bitcoin Price Forecasting
pmc-12730464.creator: Ceren Baştemur Kaya, Ebubekir Kaya, Eyüp Sıramkaya, Heming Jia, Gang Hu
pmc-12730464.description: This study introduces two hybrid forecasting models that integrate the Marine Predators Algorithm (MPA) with Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) and Feed-Forward Neural Networks (FFNN) for short-term Bitcoin price prediction. Daily Bitcoin data from 2022 were converted into supervised time-series structures with multiple input configurations.

pmc-12996668.title: One-year clinical, radiological, and functional outcomes following antifungal therapy for aspergillus infection in lung transplant recipients
pmc-12996668.creator: Ariane Lelièvre, Marlène Murris, Marion Dupuis, Jean Mourlanette, Aurélie Le Borgne, Samia Collot, Olivier Marion, Nassim Kamar, Nicolas Guibert, Thomas Villeneuve
pmc-12996668.description: BackgroundAspergillus is the most frequent fungal pathogen after lung transplantation, ranging from asymptomatic colonization to invasive disease. Treatment outcomes of aspergillosis in real-life settings remain insufficiently characterized because of the complexity and heterogeneity of its clinical presentations.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective study of all adult lung transplant recipients followed at Toulouse University Hospital from 2014 to 2024.

pmc-13572829.title: Static Drainage H2/O2 PEM Fuel Cells Enabled by Water Transport Plates: Pore‐Scale Design and Transport Mechanisms
pmc-13572829.creator: Mengdi Guo, Diankai Qiu, Dong Zhu, Linfa Peng
pmc-13572829.description: As the suitability of proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) for underwater and space applications gains broader recognition, dead‐ended operation has attracted increasing attention. However, water management challenges are exacerbated in PEMFCs without high‐rate purge flows. Flooding frequently occurs, and thus hinders long‐term stable operation.
